about.title: Who is Vinícius?
paragraphs: Vinícius moves between business operations and software building — an uncommon combination born from hands-on experience in customer service, technical support and administrative processes, and evolved into a serious commitment to programming and data.

Currently studying Computer Science (UNIP) and Software Engineering (UNICID), he builds with Python, JavaScript and React, and uses data — Pandas, NumPy and SQL — to automate processes and support decisions.
The common thread is analytical thinking: understanding a business problem deeply before writing the first line of code, and using technology as a tool to solve something real.
